summary: v11.0.11.02 Enterprise Web Release: Full Suite 88% Responsive Inspection Modals for Quotations, Returns & Credit/Debit Notes, Auto-Fitting Non-Colliding Metric Cards & Zero Legacy Drawers
highlights: 1. Full Suite 88% Responsive Document Inspection Modals: Quotations (QuotationDocumentInspectionDialog), Sales & Purchase Returns (ReturnDocumentInspectionDialog), and Credit & Debit Notes (CreditDebitNoteInspectionDialog) fully modernized to match Desktop v11.0.11 standard.

2. Eliminated Legacy 380px Inline Drawers: Stripped cramped side drawers across all five register views (quotations.html, sales-returns.html, purchase-returns.html, credit-notes.html, debit-notes.html); data tables now expand to 100% full width.

3. Responsive Auto-Fitting Metric Strip: Upgraded CSS inspection overview grid from fixed 4-column squish to responsive grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)) with dedicated 3-card variant, guaranteeing zero card collision or text clipping.

4. Default Tab 1 Active State & Comprehensive Tab Switching: Standardized all inspection modals to open directly with Tab 1 active and populated (Items/Lines/Impact) while supporting seamless transitions to Settlement, Notes, and Audit tabs.

5. Deep Line-Item Hydration: Upgraded Quotation, Return, and Note controllers to dynamically hydrate nested lines, tax breakdowns, origin invoices, and settlement records with full action menus (Convert to Sale, Record Refund, Print PDF, Barcode).
